acceptance_scope: Experimental VerifiedAgent integration and executable response/source contracts, with related budget accounting and runner normalization.
review_scope: Request/risk extraction integrity, mandatory policy vetoes, and primary/secondary issue handling.
Action prerequisites, known-fact exclusions, exact alternative audits and bounded reselection.
Handoff destination selection and exact final response integrity.
Source freshness, snapshot integrity, claim issue/device/plan/region scope, and current official authority.
Request deadline handling, retry attempt/token accounting, unknown usage reporting, and failure outcomes.
Follow-up runner use of shared input normalization and actual frozen policy version in traces.

findings_resolved.finding: Default source date was frozen at agent construction, allowing an old singleton to authorize expired sources.
findings_resolved.resolution: Resolve the UTC source date per request unless an explicit study date is supplied; regression covers both live and frozen behavior.

findings_resolved.finding: Specialist student-verification handoff ignored locked deterministic security/money/legal risk when the extracted frame omitted it.
findings_resolved.resolution: Specialist eligibility now requires a validated PolicyDecision and considers its flags and reason; generic fallbacks cannot authorize the specialist.

findings_resolved.finding: Final integrity rejection could return another invalid handoff without validating the replacement.
findings_resolved.resolution: Validate the handoff replacement with its own allowed URLs and use a source-independent holding reply if it also fails.

findings_resolved.finding: Reviewed claim issue restrictions were recorded but not enforced by applicability checks.
findings_resolved.resolution: ClaimScope and KnowledgeStore now require matching issue context; actions pass that context and bundled canonical issue scopes are aligned.

findings_resolved.finding: A local-policy source could authorize a current external procedure or destination.
findings_resolved.resolution: Source-backed applicability requires current_official authority by default; local response policy remains separate.

findings_resolved.finding: Input cleaning erased brand-handle targets, allowing explicit directed abuse to become an automatic reply under permissive model output.
findings_resolved.resolution: Normalize known brand handles to Spotify before legacy cleaning; integration tests cover brand variants and benign incidental profanity.

findings_resolved.finding: Runtime summaries and API trace totals omitted provider attempts or usage unavailable from successful CallMeta records.
findings_resolved.resolution: Use request-budget counters for retry-inclusive known attempts and usage; trace explicitly identifies unknown and replayed usage.

findings_resolved.finding: Successful provider responses with missing or partial usage were incorrectly treated as complete zero-cost observations.
findings_resolved.resolution: Track unknown_usage for every incomplete provider response and propagate it to cost completeness reporting.

validation.stage: Independent acceptance suite after reported fixes, before the two follow-up refactors
validation.command: python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_verified_agent.py tests/test_verified_actions.py tests/test_request_policy.py tests/test_knowledge.py tests/test_llm_budget.py tests/test_verified_experiment.py
validation.execution: Offline tests with fake or mocked model/provider responses; no model or network calls.

validation.stage: Focused verification of follow-up changes at the recorded hashes
checks: Shared normalize_input preserves three known brand targets and is idempotent.
Incidental profanity addressed to the brand remains outside deterministic directed-abuse findings.
Other customer handles continue to be anonymized.
Runner exception rows for VerifiedAgent use the same normalize_input result as the agent.

follow_up_changes_accepted: Extract and reuse normalize_input in the agent and runner, including runner resume checks and failure rows.
Bind the trace policy_version to POLICY_VERSION instead of an independent hard-coded label.
limitations: This is an AI code acceptance artifact for a specific reviewed version, not final release acceptance.
Live reply quality, held-out performance, human annotations, judge calibration and deployment promotion are not accepted by this record.
No model or network calls were made during this review; current-source factual verification belongs to the separate knowledge review.
The 244-test result precedes the two small follow-up refactors; those changes received the recorded focused verification before hashes were captured.
Hashes identify reviewed bytes. A file listed here was reviewed only within the stated scope; this record does not assert a complete audit of all historical code or experiment machinery.
